request.note: No payload. The handler does not read `data`.

confirm.note: The handler declares a new `data` at once (node/server.js:5448)

responses.name: Data
responses.when: You have a character with `player.tracker` set: your inventory holds a `tracker` or a `supercomputer`.

fields.name: monsters_diff
fields.description: Extra score per monster type: a kill of a monster worth more than 1 adds `score - 1` (node/server.js:2760, 2807). The tracker adds it to `monsters`.

fields.name: maps
fields.description: The drop table of each map (`D.drops.maps`), with `global` and `global_static`.

fields.name: tables
fields.description: Each table that a `[chance, "open", table]` row names, from every table in this payload. Also the exchange table of each exchangeable item: key `<item>`, or `<item><level>` for an item that you upgrade or compound.

fields.name: max
fields.description: `player.max_stats` of your account: `{monsters: {<type>: [kills, character name]}, level}`, the best character of the account for each monster type (node/server.js:11663-11675).

fields.name: monsters_home_server
fields.description: The drop tables of monsters on their home server (`D.drops.monsters_home_server`), or `{}`. These are drop tables, not kill counts.

fields.name: drops
fields.description: The drop table of each monster type (`D.drops.monsters`). The code for a filtered list (only types with 100 kills) does not run: its condition is `player.computer || 1`.

fields.name: global
fields.description: `D.drops.maps.global`: the table that every kill rolls. Present when the table exists (an empty array also counts).

confirm.note: The drop tables are `D.drops`, the live copy of `G.drops`

rows.when: `player.tracker` is not set: no `tracker` and no `supercomputer` in your inventory.
